title: Porch Pro Reviews: Is Porch Worth It for Contractors?

facts.fact: The article was published by Townsquare Interactive on March 1, 2022.
The article says Porch has a partnership with Lowe's, which it describes as one of Porch's main draws.
facts.quote: One of Porch’s main draws is its partnership with Lowe’s

facts.fact: According to the article, citing Porch Pro reviews, Porch is similar to other pay-per-lead companies such as Angi and HomeAdvisor.
facts.quote: According to Porch Pro reviews, Porch is similar to other pay-per-lead companies, such as Angi and Home Advisor.

facts.fact: The article says Porch has homeowners enter a timeline and budget for their project, and that multiple pros in the area are alerted upon submission.
facts.quote: It has homeowners enter a timeline and budget for the project they need a pro for.

facts.fact: The article states that Porch lead generation is portrayed as inconsistent in many Porch Pro reviews, a third-party characterization rather than a measured figure.
facts.quote: Porch lead generation is portrayed as inconsistent in many Porch Pro reviews
